report.headline: Google Ads restructured, Meta Ads optimised, and form tracking restored mid-peak week

done.text: Launched new Ken videos in the English 28-States Meta campaign and paused two underperforming videos that were generating no calls.

Overhauled Google Ads: blocked irrelevant searches (competitor brands, price comparisons, generic plan searches), switched all keywords to exact match, and raised Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement budgets to $50 per day each to maximise reach during Annual Enrollment through December 7. Also added a click-to-call tracking signal on the website to monitor whether ad visitors are attempting to call.

Found and fixed a broken form on the homepage: submissions now redirect to the thank-you page correctly, and the lead form conversion tracking event is firing again. No real leads were missed during the outage.
Added the seminar waitlist tag to 29 verified older contacts. No invitations or workflow enrollments were triggered, and all 29 updates completed with zero errors.

in_progress.text: Paused a local Meta ad set that spent $142 in 7 days with no calls. Reduced the local campaign budget from $40 to $10 per day and shifted the $30 saved to the two 28-States campaigns that are generating calls at the lowest cost.

Auto-create opportunities workflows are built and QA-tested: they correctly copy the lead source, avoid duplicate opportunities, and fall back to the actual entry channel when the source is unknown. Workflows are saved but not yet live, pending final checks on Meta/Instagram form receipt and your approval to activate.

Seminar guest reminder emails (confirmation, 7-day, 3-day, and 24-hour) are enabled on all four calendars. We are still missing the guest name list from LeadingResponse to complete the guest confirmation step.
New-booking sync and Samir's historical booking are verified. One review SMS for one contact is prepared and ready to send pending your confirmation.

waiting_on_you.text: Seminar guest names: could you share the guest list or export from LeadingResponse? We need it to finish confirming guests who were added after the main registrant booked.
October seminar attendance lists: could you share the check-in lists for October 6, 8, 10, 13, 15, and 17? We have 188 contacts still needing verified attendance to complete the pipeline cleanup.
Review SMS approval: we have one review request ready to send. Please confirm we can release it so we can verify delivery and close out this task.

Ken tracking number test: could you arrange one call to Ken's number with Ken available to answer? Please let us know if his phone rings, for how long, and when the voicemail/AI picks up, along with the caller's last four digits and call time, so we can check the logs.
Auto-create opportunities: please review the workflow setup and approve activation when ready. We can also walk you through which historical opportunities would be backfilled before we turn it on.

next_week.text: If the restructured Google Ads setup does not produce leads in the next few days, we plan to test a small Performance Max campaign that shows ads across more of Google, and will share results before increasing spend.
Launch additional Ken videos in Meta campaigns once they are ready, and increase local campaign budget when new creative is live.
Activate the auto-create opportunities workflows in production and monitor one week of live leads for any blank sources once approved.

internal_flags.text: Form Tracking: a specialist post on 2026-11-23 noted the homepage form was not redirecting to the thank-you page and the lead form event was not firing. This was fixed the same day, and the specialist confirmed no real leads were missed. Worth verifying independently given this was their peak week. The item is marked Done.

Booking Sync: a lead post on 2026-11-20 flags that a workflow failure from November 5 was not caught until November 20 (two weeks). Check whether we have alerting in place for contacts that stall mid-workflow so this does not recur.

$100 Budget / Google Ads: the specialist noted a conversion tracking inconsistency on the website on 2026-11-23 and pinged another team member. Confirm this was resolved and whether it overlaps with the Form Tracking fix or is a separate issue.

Ken Tracking Number: the item is in Waiting status. The lead's test call on 2026-11-20 went straight to Voice AI instead of reaching Ken. As of 2026-11-25 the specialist is still awaiting a coordinated retest. Flag to ensure this is resolved before more spend goes to Ken's campaign.

Auto-create opportunities: 271 blank-source Sales opportunities were found in the audit. The specialist clarifies this includes historical and test records, not all new missed leads. Confirm the actual count of missed live leads before presenting any numbers to the client.
